scenes.line1: Ever needed to undo a model change?
scenes.say: Ever needed to undo a model change? How do you actually keep track of every model version?

scenes.label: Trace
scenes.sub: Versioning lets you audit, rollback, and reproduce models.
scenes.say: Versioning lets you audit, roll back, and reproduce your models. It's your safety net in production.
You track your training code, the exact data, and all parameters. Tools like MLflow or DVC make this easy.

scenes.title: Model Registry
scenes.say: For example, MLflow can list your model versions. You see what data and features each version used.

scenes.question: Is saving model files enough?
scenes.wrong: Yes, just save the model file.
scenes.right: Nope! You need code, data, and parameters for true reproducibility.
scenes.say: Is saving just the model file enough? Nope! You need code, data, and parameters for true reproducibility.
